meta.title: Two bids: award all 10 units to Vendor A (not the lowest); approver approves with a remark
gaps: The required second bid from Vendor B at 90 and the comparison proving Vendor A is not the lowest bidder; the prepared state contains exactly one bid and bidding is already closed.
The Awarded Vendors counter of 1/2; the prepared state contains only one vendor bid.
Filling and submitting the proposal's required fields as a separate proposal-page workflow; award_event submits the proposal as one combined action.
Signing in as the separate approver and approving with the remark "OK — QA"; the catalog only supports approval by the current buyer account.
Verifying that the event moves to the History tab after approval.

steps.note: Open the API-prepared closed RFQ directly in Master QCS; the prepared-state rules require this as the first step.
Confirm the prepared state has one real vendor column, documenting that the required two-vendor comparison is unavailable.
Open the awarding flow for the closed event.
Allocate the available line item to the named Vendor A.
Assert that the available line item and one available vendor are selected.
Submit the award proposal to Vendor A using the supported combined awarding action.
Verify that the award proposal was created and submitted.

args.need: sign in as the assigned approver, open the submitted proposal, enter the remark "OK — QA", and approve it

steps.note: The separate approver session cannot be performed by the catalog and is required before downstream PO creation.
Create the purchase order after approval, when the tester has completed the missing approver action.
Verify that the resulting PO contains the awarded line with quantity 10.
